card.summary: The S. 539 PROTECT Our Children Reauthorization Act of 2025 reauthorizes and updates federal programs focused on preventing and investigating the online exploitation of children. Specifically, it extends the National Strategy for Child Exploitation Prevention and Interdiction and the Internet Crimes Against Children (ICAC) Task Force Program through fiscal year 2028, provides increased funding levels, updates reporting requirements, and grants certain legal liabilities protections to ICAC task forces regarding their lead prioritization decisions.
card.title: PROTECT Our Children Reauthorization Act of 2025

card.summary: S. 1071, titled the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2026 and designated as Public Law No. 119-60, establishes the policies, authorizations, and funding levels for U.S. national defense programs, military construction, Department of Energy national security programs, intelligence activities, and maritime and Coast Guard operations. The legislation spans eight divisions covering defense acquisitions, authorizations for foreign affairs and intelligence, Coast Guard management and maritime safety reforms, security policies regarding foreign nations and illicit trafficking, and various other administrative matters.
card.title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2026
